mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders(user_id, product_id, order_no, quantity, amount, status, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{orderNo}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, order_no AS orderNo, quantity, amount, status, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, order_no AS orderNo, quantity, amount, status, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, order_no AS orderNo, quantity, amount, status, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 2, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
